chatRef.description: Opaque deployment-scoped reference to one chat. It MUST be a keyed digest over a deployment secret, such as HMAC-SHA256(deployment secret, identifier). A bare digest of a channel identifier is non-conforming: low-entropy identifiers such as numeric chat ids and phone numbers are exhaustively invertible.

senderRef.description: Opaque deployment-scoped reference to one participant, constructed under the same keyed-digest requirement as chatRef.
